common_zh: 使用 $proteus-skills，仅通过 proteus_automatic_api 公开 API，从已确认并经原生保存的 STM32 模板定义创建空白工程。用 Library.search/get 查询选择 MCU、BUTTON、电阻和 LED，复用已有定义，逐件放置、逐条连线。配置 3.3 V 的 VCC/VDD 电源轨，将 VCC、VDD、VDDA 映射到该轨，VSS、VSSA 映射到 GND；NRST、VBAT、VREF+ 接电源，BOOT0、VSS 接地。先绑定按钮再保存重开，用本次编译的 HEX 配置固件。电阻先设 470 Ω，再经 Session.set_properties 改为 330 Ω。所有元件、导线和文字在图框内留白排列，必要时用 label_offsets 调整文字。连续被动录制空白、查选件、逐件放置、逐线连接、配置及验证；文件修改后可通过新 Session 显示，同步展示真实 API 调用和查询结果，不使用 Computer Use、私有助手或完成态截图拼接伪造过程。保存关闭后重开检查工程并导出原生 SDF，再用实际 GPIO 日志核对以下行为，交付工程、HEX、脚本、SDF、验证记录和 GIF，保持模板不变。
common_en: Use $proteus-skills and only public proteus_automatic_api APIs to create an empty project from a confirmed STM32 template that has been saved natively. Query and select the MCU, BUTTON, resistor and LED with Library.search/get, reuse existing definitions, and place and wire each item individually. Configure a 3.3 V VCC/VDD rail: bind VCC, VDD and VDDA to it, and VSS and VSSA to GND. Connect NRST, VBAT and VREF+ to the supply, and BOOT0 and VSS to ground. Bind the buttons before saving and reopening, then configure the firmware using the HEX compiled for this run. Start each resistor at 470 ohms and change it to 330 ohms through Session.set_properties. Keep components, wires and text clearly spaced inside the drawing frame; use label_offsets where needed. Passively record the continuous workflow from the blank sheet through actual selection, individual placement, wiring, configuration and verification. A new Session may display each saved file edit; show real API calls and query results in a synchronized log. Do not use Computer Use, private helpers or completed screenshots to fabricate the process. Save, close, reopen, check the project and export a native SDF, then verify the behavior below using actual GPIO logs. Deliver the project, HEX, script, SDF, validation records and GIF without changing the template.

hold.zh: 制作 STM32F103R6 按住点灯示例，使用本次编译的 firmware/hold.hex。SW1 为常开 BUTTON，一端接 3.3 V，另一端接 U1.PA0-WKUP；固件使用 PA0 内部下拉。U1.PA5 经 R1 串接 D1 阳极，D1 阴极接地。按公共要求从空白完成选件、布局、连线、绑定和参数配置。分段执行初始松开、按下 SW1、松开 SW1，再按下、再松开，每步继续仿真并记录实际时间。从本次 GPIO 日志验证 PA5 依次为 0→1→0→1→0，输入变化后的对应区间必须出现输出响应，不能只用按钮状态或网表宣称点灯成功。录制中展示两轮按下亮、松开灭，结果同时保留结构及响应证据。
hold.en: Build an STM32F103R6 hold-to-light example using firmware/hold.hex compiled for this run. Connect normally open BUTTON SW1 between 3.3 V and U1.PA0-WKUP; the firmware enables PA0's internal pull-down. Connect U1.PA5 through R1 to D1's anode and ground D1's cathode. Follow the common requirements to select, place, wire, bind and configure everything from an empty sheet. Run successive stages: initially released, press SW1, release SW1, press again, release again. Continue simulation after each action and record actual simulation times. Verify PA5 levels 0→1→0→1→0 from this run's GPIO logs, with each response in the interval after its input change. Button state or a netlist alone does not prove the LED behavior. Record both press-on/release-off cycles and retain structural and response evidence.

toggle.zh: 制作 STM32F103R6 单键切换灯示例，使用本次编译的 firmware/toggle.hex。常开按钮 SW1 接在 3.3 V 与 U1.PA0-WKUP 之间；PA0 内部下拉。U1.PA5 经 R1 接 D1 阳极，阴极接地。按公共要求从空白完成工程，并通过原生属性接口把 R1 从 470 Ω 改为 330 Ω。固件仅在按钮上升沿翻转 PA5。依次验证初始松开、首次按下、继续保持、首次松开、第二次按下、第二次松开，每段继续仿真，PA5 必须为 0、1、1、1、0、0。特别核对保持按下和松开不会再次翻转；用本次真实 GPIO 事件及实际时间证明，不能把某段没有日志直接当作低电平。录制应包含完整搭建和这六段操作。
toggle.en: Build an STM32F103R6 single-button toggle example using firmware/toggle.hex compiled for this run. Connect normally open SW1 between 3.3 V and U1.PA0-WKUP, with PA0's internal pull-down enabled. Connect U1.PA5 through R1 to D1's anode and ground the cathode. Follow the common requirements to build the project from an empty sheet, including changing R1 from 470 to 330 ohms through the native property API. The firmware toggles PA5 only on a button rising edge. Verify six successive stages: initially released, first press, continue holding, first release, second press, second release. Continue simulation in every stage and require PA5 levels 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0. In particular, holding or releasing must not cause another toggle. Use actual GPIO events and simulation times from this run; absence of a new event alone does not imply a low level. Record the entire build and all six stages.

dual.zh: 制作 STM32F103R6 双按钮独立点灯示例，使用本次编译的 firmware/dual.hex。常开 SW1、SW2 各从 3.3 V 接到 U1.PA0-WKUP、U1.PA1，固件分别启用内部下拉。U1.PA5 经 R1 接 D1 阳极，U1.PA6 经 R2 接 D2 阳极，两灯阴极接地。两路分区留白，按公共要求逐件放置连线、绑定两按钮，并将两个电阻由 470 Ω 原生改为 330 Ω。依次执行全松开、按下 SW1、保持 SW1 并按下 SW2、松开 SW1、松开 SW2；每步继续仿真。按 PA5、PA6 顺序验证输出向量 00→10→11→01→00，并检查一路操作不会错误改变另一路。录制完整搭建、配置和五个状态，用当前 GPIO 日志和实际事件时间验证独立控制。
dual.en: Build an STM32F103R6 two-button independent LED example using firmware/dual.hex compiled for this run. Connect normally open SW1 and SW2 from 3.3 V to U1.PA0-WKUP and U1.PA1 respectively; the firmware enables both internal pull-downs. Connect U1.PA5 through R1 to D1's anode and U1.PA6 through R2 to D2's anode, grounding both cathodes. Leave clear space between the two channels. Follow the common requirements to place and wire each item, bind both buttons and change both resistors from 470 to 330 ohms through the native API. Run five stages: both released, press SW1, keep SW1 pressed and press SW2, release SW1, release SW2. Continue simulation after every action. In PA5, PA6 order, require output vectors 00→10→11→01→00 and check that operating one channel does not incorrectly change the other. Record the full build, configuration and all five states, verifying independent control with this run's GPIO logs and actual event times.
